title: Pip and the Tapping Tub
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, first long vowels ai, ee, igh, 38-sound stage.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow standing beside a large grey rain tub in a garden.
Pip the sparrow sitting very still beside the tub, head tilted, listening to a tapping sound.
Pip the sparrow sitting with his eyes closed beside the tub, deliberately not looking inside.
A thought-bubble style view above Pip showing small pictures of Ned the duckling and Nell the bee.
Pip the sparrow looking over the rim of the grey tub, spotting Ned the duckling down inside it.
Ned the duckling down inside the tub, tapping the grey side of it with his beak.
Pip the sparrow looking down at Ned inside the tub, both smiling.
Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling sitting together beside the grey tub.
